ai_summary: Amanta Healthcare Limited reported strong Q2 FY27 results, with 17% year-on-year revenue growth and 26% PAT growth, driven by the commissioning of SteriPort Line 3, which expanded capacity by 75%, and a new captive solar plant structurally reducing power costs. The company is strategically focused on high-value Small Volume Parenterals and aims for 20%+ revenue CAGR and 25%+ EBITDA margins over the next two years, supported by continued deleveraging and robust product demand. While successfully navigating raw material price volatility, sustained growth hinges on the timely commercialization of its extensive product pipeline and full utilization of newly added capacities.
